title: The three-quarter exponent for honeycomb self-avoiding walk

result.label: The three-quarter exponent for honeycomb self-avoiding walk
result.statement: Proves the diameter form of Nienhuis's predicted three-quarter exponent: a uniformly chosen n -step self-avoiding walk on the honeycomb lattice has diameter n^ 3/4+o(1) . Its local mass and covering numbers have exponent 4/3. These estimates hold at every sufficiently large fixed length, simultaneously across scales, with arbitrarily high polynomial probability.
